notes:
Summary: POC failed to meet Pioneer Conversational Labs' latency SLO for live streaming assistant. Key points:
- Business: customer building consumer-facing real-time assistant (mobile + web). UX is sensitive to sub-200ms p95 for short exchanges; target throughput ~300 concurrent users for initial launch.
- Tech findings: streaming via SSE/websocket shows tokenization + tail-latency spikes. Measured p95 ~650-800ms for 1-3 turn conversations when using Redwood hosted API with our default batching and KV-cache settings. Jitter on client reconnects observed (FF id ff-20260211-8b3d, logs in INF-1127).
- Workarounds attempted: reduced batching size, disabled continuous batching, forced immediate token flush; improved median but p95 still above target. Tried model fallback to smaller quantized variant — latency improved but degraded coherence in multi-turn; customer flagged hallucination/regression risk.
- Customer comments: "We need consistent 200ms or better — spikes kill the product experience."
- Sales context: initial enthusiasm post-demo but momentum slowed after internal re-org; no clear champion now in product org. Finance paused new subscriptions due to Q2 budget hold. Competitor (Anthropic/OpenAI) reports better streaming spine in their internal tests; Pioneer moved to pilot with competitor for critical streaming path.
- Security/ops: Pioneer requires SSO/SAML, audit logs, and KMS. They prefer VPC/private peering for PII workloads. Those are supported but become moot if latency cannot be met.
- Outcome: Deal currently stalled/closed-lost for primary streaming use case. We should keep a technical post-mortem and share remediation plan if engineering can fix p95 tail latencies.
- Suggested internal actions: escalate kernel/batching team, run targeted perf matrix (seq len distribution 8-512), validate SSE flush semantics end-to-end, propose Dedicated reserved pool with isolation + tuned kernel set as a follow-up (if Product approves prioritization).
notes_short: POC missed p95 SLO for streaming; customer piloting competitor; budget freeze + no champion.
